message.content: {"caption":"Three-panel line chart comparing hard scores across epoch checkpoints for SpreadsheetBench, SearchQA, and LiveMath.","description":"The chart has three side-by-side panels, each with epoch checkpoint on the x-axis and hard score on the y-axis. The legend identifies Train rollout (blue solid line with circle markers), Selection best (orange dashed line with square markers), and Unseen test (green dash-dot line with triangle markers). SpreadsheetBench uses checkpoints 1, 2, 4, and 8; its y-axis runs from 0.3 to 1.0. Train rollout stays near 0.87–0.88 through checkpoint 4, then rises to about 0.92 at 8. Selection best rises from about 0.37 at 1 to 0.80 at 2 and remains level. Unseen test rises from about 0.50 to 0.71, then edges upward to about 0.75. SearchQA uses checkpoints 1, 2, 4, 8, 12, and 16; its y-axis runs from 0.82 to 0.88. Train rollout rises from about 0.827 to 0.863 by checkpoint 4, dips to about 0.842 at 12, and returns to about 0.863 at 16. Selection best rises from about 0.845 to 0.865 at checkpoint 2 and stays level. Unseen test starts near 0.850, peaks near 0.863 at checkpoint 4, then settles around 0.858–0.860. LiveMath uses checkpoints 1, 2, 4, 8, 12, and 16; its y-axis runs from 0.45 to 0.85. Train rollout fluctuates, rising from about 0.515 to 0.63 at checkpoint 2, dropping to about 0.57 at 4 and 8, then climbing to about 0.655 at 16. Selection best is nearly level around 0.765 through checkpoint 12 before rising to about 0.825 at 16. Unseen test rises from about 0.565 to about 0.62 at checkpoint 4, then declines to around 0.565 and stays there.
